from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal,json,tempfile
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe');base='9e5a5c9016245a1162597e548060bc5543152316'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='jobpipe-live-cli-') as tmp:
 folder=Path(tmp);fields=folder/'fields.json';bank=folder/'answers.json'
 from_dummy={"version":1,"answers":[{"question":"Do you use AI in your role? ✱","answer":"SYNTHETIC_NEVER_EXPOSE","scope":"employer","employer":"Ethena","human_verified":True}]}
 bank.write_text(json.dumps(from_dummy));bank.chmod(0o600)
 cmd=[str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'jobctl.py','ats-capture-review','--url','https://jobs.lever.co/ethena/f85bcfd1-8d2c-4cf5-a6ab-1c8ddab14c65/apply','--output',str(fields),'--bank',str(bank),'--employer','Ethena','--verified-profile-keys','full_name,email,phone']
 p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
 try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=85)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);raise SystemExit('TIMEOUT')
 print('CLI_EXIT',p.returncode,'ERROR',e[-700:],flush=True)
 if p.returncode:raise SystemExit('LIVE_CLI_FAILED')
 assert 'SYNTHETIC_NEVER_EXPOSE' not in o
 d=json.loads(o);captured=json.loads(fields.read_text())
 assert d['input_field_count']==len(captured)>0
 assert d['review_item_count']>0 and d['submission']=='not_attempted'
 assert all(set(x)=={'type','question','label','required','ambiguous'} for x in captured)
 assert fields.stat().st_mode&0o777==0o600
 print('LIVE_JOBCTL_CAPTURE_REVIEW',json.dumps({'fields':len(captured),'review_items':d['review_item_count'],'verified_profile_candidates':len(d['verified_candidates']),'synthetic_verified_answer_matches':d['verified_answer_match_count'],'private_mode':'0600','no_value_leak':True,'submission':'not_attempted'},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==base
print('VERIFIED_READONLY_CLI_END_TO_END',flush=True)
